desc: 深青水线玻璃棚拍的矮身罩盖奶瓶，冷钢台面与点圈引线九屏详情
leaf: 矮身宽口径透明罩盖奶瓶
name: 深青水线玻璃点圈奶瓶款

shots.intent: 用深青棚色加一块带水线的清玻璃与拉丝钢台面，一眼看清矮身宽瓶身、宽瓶盖环与透明罩盖的整体轮廓，抢到首屏停留与点击
shots.textZone: 上部三分之一留白带放一条中文主标与一条发丝线，线下小字副标前一枚点圈索引

shots.intent: 把选购时最常被问到的三件事做成三条钢轨疑问条，点圈索引加空白标签位，条目全部交给占位符，不复述源图的功效与进口断言
shots.textZone: 顶部一条中文标题与一条发丝线，三条钢轨各一枚点圈索引与一行空白标签位

shots.intent: 第三屏就把产品放进冷光居家语境让人代入，成人从肩下取景、孩子只留背影且全程被托抱，用一只水杯锚定真实尺度
左侧低掠射微距交代罩盖、宽瓶盖环与坐在瓶口内的奶嘴的装配关系，三枚点圈引线撑起做工信任而绝不写结构与功效断言
shots.textZone: 三枚点圈引线标签位分置上方与左右，左下一条结构小标题

shots.intent: 正俯视两块各带水线的清玻璃板做左右对照，右板立本品、左板整块留白给卖家自贴，保留对照骨架但不虚构对手品与胜负结论
shots.textZone: 顶部一条对照标题与一条发丝线，两板下方各一枚点圈与一行空白标签位

shots.intent: 以正侧 90 度交代矮身宽瓶身的轮廓语言与标签空白区，三枚点圈引线把轮廓条目交给占位符，杜绝尺寸与材质杜撰
shots.textZone: 左侧一列：一条轮廓小标题加一条发丝线与三枚点圈引线标签位

shots.intent: 把参考图里真实存在的一高一矮两支同款前后错落立成选款屏，点圈选款位留空，不写容量尺寸也不新造颜色
shots.textZone: 两支下方各一枚点圈与一行空白选款标签，顶部一条选款小标题与一条发丝线

shots.intent: 复刻源图的信任与档案结构但改为点圈空白档案行加一块空白留证玻璃板，字段与数值全部留空，杜绝证书材质参数杜撰
shots.textZone: 顶部一节标题加一条发丝线，其下五行点圈空白档案条目，下方一整块空白留证玻璃板

shots.intent: 以同一深青水线视觉左右分栏收口，点圈行动环只承载一条不超过八字的引导语，把转化动作交给不编造事实的占位符
shots.textZone: 左部留白带放结束标题、一枚点圈行动环内的一条短引导语与两枚点圈空白标签位

style.backgroundSystem: a deep teal #0E4750 seamless studio cyclorama with one freestanding clear glass sheet carrying a live water line in its lower third, the bottle standing on a brushed-steel #A7B3B9 slab with a hairline 90-degree front edge and a fine unidirectional grain, flat layout screens built on a pale water-line #D9E4E5 glass-edged panel over the same teal field; never limewash plaster, never an arched niche, never stacked steps or block tiers, never a fabric or linen interior, never a podium disc, never a sphere cluster, never a gradient card, never a warm, wood or dark field
style.direction: cool deep-teal slate and brushed-steel maternal-infant feeding bottle commerce
style.iconSystem: thin dotted circles only: every index and callout marker is a circle built from evenly spaced dots at one single stroke weight in cool teal #4E8D93 on pale fields or pale #D9E4E5 on the teal field, and every callout leader is one hairline rule that starts on the referenced part with one small solid cool-teal dot and ends on an empty label line; never filled circular stamps, never knocked-out solid chips, never rounded-square squircle frames, never boxed icon sets, never bare numerals, never dashed square-chain leaders, never stars, medals, rosettes or clouds, never a second line weight
style.lightingSystem: cool key at about 6100K entering from camera left at a moderately high side angle, one crisp narrow specular running down the left flank of the clear dome and one bright hairline along the steel edge, a low brushed-steel bounce from camera right lifting the shadow side, one defined cool contact shadow pooling to camera right and a shallow non-mirror sheen under the base, medium contrast, no warm cast and no front-top wash
style.lockText: Campaign Style Lock: consistent cool deep-teal, slate and brushed-steel maternal-infant feeding bottle commerce visual system across the entire image set; fixed palette of deep teal base #0E4750, pale water-line grey-white #D9E4E5, brushed steel #A7B3B9 surfaces, slate ink text #22343B and one cool teal accent #4E8D93 reserved for all markers and leaders; cool colour temperature at about 6100K throughout; background system limited to a deep teal #0E4750 seamless studio cyclorama with one freestanding clear glass sheet carrying a live water line in its lower third, the bottle standing on a brushed-steel slab with a hairline 90-degree front edge and a fine unidirectional grain, flat layout screens on a pale water-line #D9E4E5 glass-edged panel, never limewash plaster, never an arched niche, never stacked steps or block tiers, never a fabric or linen interior, never a podium disc, never a sphere cluster, never a gradient card and never a warm, wood or dark field; cool key at about 6100K from camera left at a moderately high side angle, one crisp narrow specular down the left flank of the clear dome, one bright hairline along the steel edge, a low brushed-steel bounce from camera right, one defined cool contact shadow pooling to camera right, a shallow non-mirror sheen under the base and medium contrast; brushed steel with real grain plus clear glass with true refraction through the water line, translucent body as soft diffusion, dome as clean refractive glass, water only as a still meniscus line with no splash and no droplets; one modern geometric Chinese sans family with a single short headline in slate ink #22343B or pale #D9E4E5, one hairline rule under every section title, no Latin overprint words, no wide-tracked kicker strips, no highlighter bands, no folded ribbon flags, no pill badges, no double-rule keyline frames and no dense body text; icon system of thin dotted circles only at one single stroke weight in cool teal #4E8D93 or pale #D9E4E5, each callout one hairline leader starting on the part with a small solid cool-teal dot and ending on an empty label line, never filled circular stamps, never squircle chips, never boxed icon sets, never bare numerals and never dashed square-chain leaders; the bottle stands upright at a stable scale with the clear dome fitted, the #EE8A73 collar ring screwed closed and the nipple fully seated inside the dome, short wide body, shoulder taper, rounded base and dome height never redrawn, the #5C2A26 band under the ring and the #7B5EA6 disc under the teat base kept at their exact reference tone and placement, any graduation marking kept exactly as shot and never added or removed, any label area left as one blank legible field, and the coral and violet tones kept as reference product tones only and never reused as a field, badge or accent colour; no color palette changes, no mixed fonts, no random backgrounds, no inconsistent lighting, no mismatched icon styles, no warm cast, no plaster or arch, no stacked steps, no linen, no podium or sphere, no new product colors, no invented numbers.
noDrift: no medical or functional-benefit wording of any kind: no anti-colic, no 「防胀气」 「不胀气」 「不倒流」 「防呛」, no air-intake, valve-efficiency, filtration or digestion claim and no mechanism caption that implies a health result
no breastfeeding-equivalence or parenting-emotion wording: no 「母乳的感觉」 「仿母乳」 「像喝母乳一样」 「每一口都是爱」 and no soothing or mother-substitute phrasing
no age or suitability indication: no 「婴儿」 「新生儿」 「宝宝专用」 「儿童」, no month or year range and no statement about who the product suits
no material or safety-grade claim: no 「PPSU」 「玻璃」 「中硼硅」 「硅胶」 「食品级」 「安全材质」 BPA-free wording and no surface-performance assertion

no sterilisation, disinfection, antibacterial or heat-resistance standard: no 「可消毒」 「耐高温」, no sterilisation-rate percentage, no pathogen name, no cycle count and no temperature or hour figure such as 「二十四h」
no origin or import claim: no 「进口」 「原装进口」, no country name, no flag artwork, no factory, supplier or heritage wording
no certificate, award, authorisation, inspection seal, test report, registration or execution-standard number, and no comparison chart carrying invented values, multiples or percentages such as 「98%」
no invented numbers anywhere: no capacity in millilitres, no dimensions, no pack or piece count, no shelf life, no price, discount, coupon, countdown or delivery time
no brand name, store name, material-site watermark, platform badge, 「加入会员」 membership corner or QR code

no infant face and no bottle at a child's mouth: a child appears only from behind or cropped above the jaw, always held and supervised by an anonymous adult framed from the shoulders down, and never left unsupervised
no loose, unsecured, detached or exploded nipple and no open collar ring: the nipple stays seated inside the closed dome in every screen
no microwave, no steam, no hot liquid touching skin, no water splash, no droplet spray and no water droplets on skin

no palette or set drift: no limewash plaster, no arched niche, no stacked steps or block tiers, no linen or fabric interior, no podium disc, no sphere cluster, no gradient card, no wood or warm field, no squircle icon chips, no filled circular stamps and no bare numerals; no mixed fonts, no recoloured product and no new colourway between screens
style.presentationRules: the bottle stands upright at a stable scale on the steel slab with the clear dome fitted, the wide #EE8A73 collar ring screwed closed and the nipple fully seated inside the dome; the short wide body, the shoulder taper, the rounded base, the dome height and the #5C2A26 band under the collar ring are never redrawn, the #7B5EA6 disc visible under the teat base keeps its exact reference placement and tone, any graduation marking stays exactly as shot and is never added or removed, and the label area always reads as one blank legible field with no redrawn wording; the product never floats without its contact shadow, is never occluded by props, one real object anchors scale inside every scene shot, vertical lines stay vertical, and the product's coral and violet tones stay reference product tones only and are never used as a field, badge or accent colour
style.surfaceSystem: brushed-steel #A7B3B9 slab with real unidirectional grain and a hard thin front edge, plus clear glass with true refraction where the water line crosses it; the translucent body renders as soft diffusion, the dome as clean refractive glass with one narrow specular, water only as a still meniscus line with no splash and no droplets
style.typography: one modern geometric Chinese sans family throughout; a single short headline in slate ink #22343B on pale fields or pale water-line #D9E4E5 on the teal field, one hairline rule under every section title and nothing else; no Latin overprint words, no wide-tracked kicker strips, no highlighter bands, no folded ribbon flags, no pill badges, no double-rule keyline frames, no dense body text, no mixed fonts
